What are your expectations for the defense this coming season?
stories.summary:
The Bills are so young on defense.  Projected starters Sanders, Hairston and Walker are all second year players, Williams (assuming he beats out Orr (r)) will be a 1st year full time starter in his 4th season.  Bishop is in his 3rd season.  Now add how much of the key depth are projected to be rookies in Orr, Pride, Parker, Kilgore, and Igbinosun. Other depth is raw in Hancock (2nd year), Andressen (3rd) and Carter (3rd, but lost 1 year plus to injuries).  
	 



	There are good to excellent vets like Chubb, Benford, Oliver and Bernard (if he can adjust to the new system and stay healthy), but there are also new vets with big question marks like Stone, Alford and Gardner-Johnson (already injured). 
	 



	Put this all together and what do you got….. ?  Honestly I have no idea.  
	 



	My heart tells me that if they stay healthy they will improve steadily throughout the season as the kids get used to the speed of the NFL and all the players get used to playing in the new scheme with a new defensive coaching staff.  My head tells me that there are going to be huge bumps in the road and Josh and the offense will have to win some shootouts to keep us in contention.

Kyler Murray named the Vikings starter
stories.summary:
JJ McCarthy was terrible last year, but are teams a little too quick to give up on  QBs? Especially ones drafted in the top 10? Murray is exciting to watch in the same way Doug Flutie or Gardner Minshew were, but I don’t think he will ever be a franchise QB. Plus, half your grade in the NFL is on attendance alone. The guy just cannot stay healthy and even when he was, he wasn’t a winner (Not in the NFL at least.) His 1.3 million dollar contract says it all. IDK Minnesota’s cap situation, but I feel like they should’ve done all they could to retain the guy w/ a 14-3 record who brought them all the way to the NFCC. Let McCarthy learn under a seasoned Vet like Jordan Love did under Rodgers. Something tells me he’ll be starting at some point this year due to injury or benching, anyways. 
	 



	https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49583297/vikings-name-kyler-murray-starting-qb-sources-say

stories.title: Observations about where we think the Bills are
stories.summary:
I find it interesting that there is so little actual football conversation going on this forum at this time of the year. There was less chatter than usual about training camp, and it was dead here between OTAs and training camp. 



	 



	For me, and I think for many of us posting here, I know pretty much what the roster is going to look like and there's not much more to be said about. I know that this should be a good team, competitive at the highest levels. Sure, I can imagine scenarios where things come apart, but any of that is just speculation. 



	 



	I'm just waiting, hoping for no injuries. Maybe one more interesting free agent signing. All the things that I really want to know about the team - how good will the defense be?, how much difference will Moore make?, will Josh take even one more step toward true greatness?, does Brady have what it takes to be a winning head coach? - are things that I can't begin to learn until the regular season gets under way.



	 



	Until then, I'm just waiting.

stories.title: Has anyone ever had a bad StubHub experience?
stories.summary:
This may or may not be the place for this. In lieu of what is happening with the World Cup tickets, I wanted to share my story. Since its peak offseason I figured I’d open Pandora’s Box.



	 



	So, I sold my tickets to the Chiefs game last year. A friend invited me to sit with her. I had an extra ticket and so did she, so we decided instead of finding 2 people at the 11th hour, I would just sell mine.
	
	I listed them late (a day or 2 before the game). I think I asked $1000 for the pair or something like that. My cut was like $896 so whatever that works out to. Before I left for the stadium the morning of the game, I switched to use the “auto upload” feature for the tickets. I figured if they sold, I wouldn’t be around to transmit the tickets. My plan was to just adjust pricing if needed.



	 



	Sure enough they sold at the asking price.  I go to the game, everything is fine. The next day, I’m driving home from somewhere and get a push notification from AMEX. My card gets charged $896!! That can’t be right, that’s what I am owed, not the other way around.



	 



	I call StubHub and am on the phone for hours. They said that I never sent the tickets and the person showed up. They refunded that person and charged me. I’m furious. 
	 



	The next day, I called my rep and asked if he could email me the screenshot of when, and where, I transferred the tickets to. He sent it over, and sure enough, it was sent to StubHub that morning. They apparently never loaded them on. They never transferred them to that person. They then charged me for it.



	 



	Over the next few months, I made dozens of calls to StubHub. I provided the documentation straight from the Ticketmaster system at the Bills. After a few months, I got a letter more or less saying, “too bad.” Now I’m even more furious, and helpless. As many of you can probably tell, I’m not quick to let things go. 😂😂



	 



	I have a bunch of friends still in ticketing. My one buddy sent me this attorney that does nothing but sue StubHub. I sent him everything. He has a multi-million dollar class action suit with them now. This World Cup situation will be a nightmare but this is independent of that. 
	 



	Last night, I received an email from him, that I am getting my money back, the penalty and interest. I don’t owe the attorney a dime. StubHub acknowledged fault in this case and hundreds of others. I’m so mad that it came to this but feel vindicated. 
	 



	Needless to say, I will never use StubHub again. They didn’t even really ever argue that I was wrong. They pretty much said, “too bad” until this attorney got on it. I am sure that I’m not alone in this but has anyone else ever had a terrible experience with them (or any other ticketing platforms)?
